/data/description	This plate shows four fishermen holding nets and creels, or fishing baskets. The plate was made during the Yongzheng reign, known for its fine porcelain decoration. Similar scenes of fishermen on Ming (1368–1644) and Qing (1644–1911) dynasty paintings and prints, such as Happy Fisherfolk CMA 2025.91.b, illustrate the popularity of the theme and its adoption by potters.
